title: Four Pararescuemen Parachute Out Over Mexico Waters to Perform Rescue Capabilities
description: Pararescuemen from the California Air National Guard's 129th Rescue Wing jump from a MC-130P Combat Shadow aircraft this past Thursday. A 36 foot vessel the Rebel Heart has a family on board with an ill child. Also available in high definition
keywords: pararescue, PJs, 129th Rescue Wing, Rebel Heart, Ca ANG, AIr Force, SAR, search and rescue, High Definition
pass_reason: Strong (PJs jump for ill 1-year-old aboard Rebel Heart, Apr 3 2014; NGB quotes verified on af.mil article 477742) but interchangeable with ccf-20261102-05 (PJ ramp jump 780 nm out) published Nov 3; only about 22 s usable footage. Revisit after Nov 10.
